answer: Follow the money home. A raven flies wide but roosts in one tree, and farmed seats usually cash out to one wallet. Rewards stay locked for a watch horizon (length is an assumption); if many identities' payouts converge on one destination, even through a short cipher of hops, that window's emission is recomputed as one seat. Evasion: many separate cash-out paths, which costs fees, time and care. Wrongly hit: exchange omnibus wallets or a shared payroll, so known custodians are exempt, it merges pay only, never slashes, and allows appeal.
